examples.question_text:
Find these benchmark percentages.
(a) $10\%$ of $87$ L.
(b) $25\%$ of $\$86$.
(c) $50\%$ of $7.4$ kg.
examples.solution_text:
(a) $10\%$ is one tenth.
$87\div10=8.7\text{ L}$.
(b) $25\%$ is one quarter. Halve, then halve again.
$86\div2=43$ and $43\div2=21.50$.
So $25\%$ of $\$86$ is $\$21.50$.
(c) $50\%$ is one half.
$7.4\div2=3.7\text{ kg}$.

examples.question_text:
Two pieces are cut from an $82$ m roll of ribbon: one is $50\%$ of the roll and the other is $25\%$ of the roll.
(a) Find the length of each piece.
(b) Find the length remaining.
examples.solution_text:
(a) $50\%\text{ of }82=82\div2=41\text{ m}$.
$25\%\text{ of }82=82\div4=20.5\text{ m}$.
(b) Length remaining $=82-41-20.5=20.5\text{ m}$.
Half and a quarter have been used, so one quarter remains.
